intro: Enhance the Windows File Explorer with classic features, improved visibility, and powerful context menu additions. Winhance gives you complete control over how File Explorer looks and behaves.

groups.Context Menu: Customize the right-click context menu with classic features and useful additions.
groups.Devices and Peripherals: Settings for device lighting and printer management.
groups.Files and Folders: Settings for file and folder display, visibility, and behavior.
groups.Navigation Pane: Control what appears in the File Explorer navigation pane (left sidebar).
groups.File Associations: Configure default applications for file types.
